jobs.description:
Technology & Transformation - AI & Data- Senior Consultant | Camunda | Bengaluru (Bengaluru, IN)

Technology & Transformation - AI & Data- Senior Consultant | Camunda | Bengaluru
• Job requisition ID : 109645 
• Location: Bengaluru
• Entity: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP 

Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad / Delhi

 

Experience: 4-8 Years

 

Education - B.tech

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Job Summary

 

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Camunda Developer to design, develop, and implement workflow automation solutions using the Camunda BPM platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in business process management (BPM), workflow orchestration, microservices architecture, and Java-based enterprise application development. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to automate and optimize business processes across the organization.

 

 Hands-on experience with Camunda 7/8

 Strong knowledge of BPMN 2.0 and workflow automation

 Experience in Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices

 API integration and REST services expertise

 Familiarity with Kafka/RabbitMQ, Docker, and Kubernetes

 Strong problem-solving and communication skills

 

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and implement business workflows using Camunda BPM Platform (Camunda 7 or Camunda 8).

Develop BPMN 2.0 workflows, DMN decision tables, and CMMN models as per business requirements.

Integrate Camunda processes with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services.

Develop custom Java delegates, external tasks, listeners, and service tasks.

Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable workflow solutions.

Design and develop REST APIs and microservices supporting business process automation.

Perform workflow optimization, debugging, performance tuning, and root-cause analysis.

Ensure process governance, security, scalability, and maintainability.

Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to BPM best practices.

Support deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting of workflow solutions across environments.

Create technical documentation, workflow diagrams, and deployment guides.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

Strong experience with Camunda BPM (Camunda 7/8).

Hands-on experience in BPMN 2.0, DMN, and workflow automation.

Proficiency in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture.

Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.

 

Development Skills

Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.

Design patterns and enterprise application development.

Version control using Git.

Unit testing and integration testing frameworks.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Camunda 8 (Zeebe Engine).

Camunda Certification (Associate Developer or Professional Certification).

Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, or Telecom domains.

Knowledge of Process Mining and Task Mining concepts.

Experience with Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Splunk.

Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

T&T | EAID | Engineering | Manager | Full Stack | Delhi (Delhi, IN)

T&T | EAID | Engineering | Manager | Full Stack | Delhi
• Job requisition ID : 103681 
• Location: Delhi
• Entity: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP 

The team 

 

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.        

 

 

Your work profile 

 

  • We are looking for Java  Architect / Technical Manager (Full Stack Backend & Front-End)  

 

 

 

Key skills required:  

  • Hands-on capabilities in Microservices and cloud based architecture 

  • Proficient in system design (HLD and LLD) and developing highly scalable, multi tenanted distributed transactional systems and mission critical applications 

  • Responsible to architect/ design on complex systems using Microservices, Event Driven design patterns using niche Cloud, Kubernetes, and system design skills 

  • Designing and developing production readiness aspects like Observability, Security, Performance and Scalability in the design 

  • Collaborate with cross functional engineering, QA, DevSecOps, Product and Business teams to meet collective org milestones 

  • Manage a team of vendor/partner developers to deliver the product roadmap 

  • Microservices system design and design patterns e.g. SAGA, Circuit Breaker, Reactive, Outpost etc. 

  • Strong hands on experience Web and Mobile front end expert with exposure to full stack development (Kotlin/SWIFT/React JS/ReactNative/Flutter) 

  • Proven experience on java, Android and swift iOs native apps, React native or Flutter 

  • Cloud experience GCP / Azure / AWS (certifications preferred) 

  • Strong on creativity for building intuitive and responsive UX 

  • Strong knowledge of big data ecosystem Databricks, Apache Spark, Big Query, NoSQL 

  • Experience in handling Non-Functional Requirements like Security, Performance, Analytics, Audit/Logging, Observability/Monitoring/Alerting, etc. 

  • Ability to work with multiple levels in the organization with key business holders 

  • Having a product mindset is very important 

  • Good verbal and written communication skills as the interaction will be with senior stakeholders and vendor key roles. 

 

 

 

Must Have: 

  • Java + React/Angular, devops, Microservices 

 

 

 

 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 

 

 

 

Location and Way of Working:  

 

  • Base location: Gurugram

jobs.description:
T&T_Customer_M&C - Senior Consultant | Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) | Mumbai (Mumbai, IN)

T&T_Customer_M&C - Senior Consultant | Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) | Mumbai
• Job requisition ID : 108391 
• Location: Mumbai
• Entity: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP 

The team

 

Customer has to do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long-term growth. Learn more about: Customer

  

Key Responsibilities:

 

  •  Provide advisory, consulting, and technical implementation services to customers on Adobe Experience Platform and Adobe Journey Optimizer.
  • Assess customer requirements, pain points, goals and make recommendations on solution architecture, design and roadmap.
  • Configure Adobe Experience Platform services like Identity Service, Data Storage Layer, Profile dataset, Real-time Customer Profile etc.
  • Implement data ingestion from various sources like CRM, MPNs, Website data, Mobile apps using APIs, Experience Data Model (XDM), schemas and mappers
  • Create customer, visitor and product audiences using segments and AI/ML powered segments.
  • Configure destinations to activate audiences in channels like email, Journey Optimizer, Ad Cloud and CRM systems.
  • Implement Journey Optimizer features like journey orchestration, triggers, automations, actions, messages and offers.
  • Develop custom applications, workflows and APIs to extend the platform as per customer needs.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues, debug and optimize performance of customer implementations.
  • Provide post go-live support, enhancements, maintenance and upgrades for customer solutions.
  • Conduct product training, knowledge transfer and share best practices.
  • Continuously track product updates and improve solution recommendations for evolving customer needs.

 

Skills and Experience

 

  • 3+ years of implementation experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products especially Adobe Experience Platform and Journey Optimizer
  • Expertise in deploying, configuring and optimizing all major Experience Platform services and Journey Optimizer features
  • Strong SQL skills for querying datasets, implementing data transformations, cleansing data, etc
  • Hands-on experience developing custom applications, workflows and integrations using Experience Platform APIs
  • Deep familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform and Journey Optimizer technical implementations including:
  • Setting up source connectors and ingesting data using the API and UI
  • Configuring Experience Events (XDM schemas) for capturing data from sources
  • Creating audience segments using custom and AI/ML-based segments
  • Triggering journeys and activations based on segments and profiles
  • Implementing journey automations, actions and messages
  • Integrating with destinations like CRM, email, etc.
  • Hands-on experience developing using the Platform APIs and SDKs in a language like:
  • JavaScript for API calls
  • Java for extending functionality with custom connectors or applications
  • Expertise in data modelling for multi-channel needs using the Experience Data Model (XDM)
  • Familiarity with configuring IMS authentication to connect external systems to Platform APIs
  • Experience developing, debugging and optimizing custom server-side applications
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, JSON, REST APIs and SQL
  • Expertise ingesting data from sources like Adobe Analytics, CRM, Ad Server, Web and Mobile
  • Strong understanding of concepts like multi-channel data management, segmentation, orchestration, automation and personalization
  • Understanding of data structures like: JSON for representing data in APIs, Data Tables for processing tabular data, Streaming data flows
  • Experience automating technical tasks using tools like: API integration tests, Postman for API testing, Git for source control
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills with the ability to clearly present technical recommendations to customers
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues related to APIs, data ingestion, segments, destinations etc.
  • Self-starter with the ability to manage resource constraints, changing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Problem solving mindset with the ability to constantly improve and optimize deployed solutions
  • Consultation and Requirement Gathering: Engage with clients to understand their technical and business requirements, conduct workshops, and gather necessary information to design and implement solutions using AEP and AJO.
  • Solution Design and Configuration: Design and configure AEP and AJO solutions to meet client requirements. This includes defining data models, configuring data flows, creating customer segments, and setting up customer journeys.
  • Implementation and Integration: Collaborate with development teams to implement and integrate AEP and AJO solutions with other systems and platforms, ensuring data flows seamlessly and accurately between systems.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Perform proactive problem diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues related to AEP and AJO. This includes identifying and resolving data integration issues, ensuring proper data synchronization, and resolving system errors.
  • Customization and Development: Develop custom solutions and extensions as needed to meet unique client requirements. This may involve scripting, programming, and leveraging AEP and AJO APIs and SDKs.
  • Documentation and Training: Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, technical specifications, and user guides. Conduct training sessions and knowledge transfer to enable clients to effectively use AEP and AJO.
  • Project Management: Collaborate with project managers to ensure successful delivery of AEP and AJO projects. This includes managing timelines, milestones, and deliverables, and providing regular project status updates.
  • Quality Assurance: Work closely with quality assurance teams to ensure the quality and stability of AEP and AJO implementations. Conduct thorough testing and validation to identify and resolve any issues or bugs.
  • Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, serving as a trusted advisor and providing ongoing support and guidance. Understand client objectives and align AEP and AJO solutions to meet their business goals.
  • Stay Updated on Product Enhancements: Keep abreast of the latest updates, features, and enhancements in AEP and AJO. Continuously expand knowledge and expertise in these platforms to provide valuable insights and recommendations to clients.

 

Location and way of working:

 

  • Base location: Mumbai
  • Education: Professional Qualification - B.E./B.Tech/MCA/MBA/MS
  • This profile involves occasional travelling to client locations.
  • Hybrid is our default way of working. Each domain has customized the hybrid approach to their unique needs.

jobs.description:
Senior Associate | Engineering Foundry & Managed Services | Bengaluru | Engineering as a Service/ Op (Bengaluru, IN)

Role: Java Full Stack Developer – Front End Engineer 

Experience: 4–8 Years  

Location: Hybrid - Bangalore 

Employment Type: Full-time 

 


About the Role 

We are seeking a skilled Frontend Engineer with strong proficiency in ReactJS and a solid understanding of modern frontend development practices. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality, scalable, and user-focused applications, leveraging modern tooling, feature flag frameworks, design systems, and internationalization libraries. 

This role involves collaboration with cross-functional teams including product, design, and backend engineering, and requires a mindset focused on code quality, reusability, and performance. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Develop and maintain high-quality, scalable UI components using ReactJS. 
  • Build and iterate on features using mock APIs with Mirage to speed up development. 
  • Collaborate closely with design teams using Figma to translate UI/UX concepts into production-ready code. 
  • Implement localization and internationalization using i18next. 
  • Manage controlled feature rollouts and experimentation using LaunchDarkly. 
  • Utilize Docker to create and maintain containerized development environments. 
  • Ensure smooth CI/CD processes using Jenkins and GitHub workflows. 
  • Work with product and engineering teams effectively using JIRA and agile practices. 
  • Leverage AI tools like GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality. 
  • Contribute to performance improvements, code reviews, and engineering best practices. 

 

Must-Have Skills 

  • ReactJS 
  • Mirage (mocking APIs)
